what: Mistake: on 14 Nov I told Sri planning makes things worse, repeating a reviewer's week-over-week comparison. A same-period check of records shows planned code jobs in November land 65% vs 45% unplanned (73% once past planning); planning costs about 3x per landing.
why: I relayed a confounded comparison (different weeks, different work) as a finding without checking planned vs unplanned jobs in the same period.
